methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: such tool does not directly measure an actual and reflect an as-is operational data of the companies' energy performance, it tracks the achievements in the key work processes or the implementation status of an Energy Management Systems (EnMS)

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Proposes a 'leading EnPI' maturity/self-assessment framework (weighted PDCA scorecard with a 0-4 EnMS implementation-maturity matrix) that tracks EnMS implementation status; the paper states the tool does not measure actual energy performance, so it lacks EnPI/EnB energy-measurement-model content (no energy indicator's variables, functional form, or estimation approach constructed).

paper_type.evidence_quote: EnMS progress measures are based on the second out of five levels of leading energy performance indicator matrix

stage1.notes: Borderline Tier-1: 'leading EnPI' is EnPI-named but a PDCA implementation-maturity scorecard, not an energy-measurement model. Case=integrated oil&gas co (upstream+refinery+transport); level_3b false.
